items.name: Silent Brasília 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa1E0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--09d9cc7a413067c02fdbbbdaf45d64b31aa1b666/Logo%20Silent%20Brasi%CC%81lia.png)

🇧🇷  **Note que este campeonato possui APENAS modalidades silenciosas!**

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SilentBrasilia2025/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista a [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Competidores participando pela primeira vez são obrigados a apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, gênero, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Favor ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes do evento, em especial os artigos específicos das modalidades da competição.

Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais.

--------------------

🇺🇸  **Please note that this competition has ONLY silent events!**

Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SilentBrasilia2025/register) tab. If you have any problem with how to register, take a look at [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, gender, date of birth and nationality. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition, especially the specific articles of the competition events.

By registering, you authorize ABRACM, WCA, and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

items.information:
We are excited to announce Warm Up Vancouver 2025! This official WCA competition will take place less than three weeks before the 2025 World Championship in Seattle.

[![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdWh2IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f989abe60a5b9303f42de97dee94ad812338f4b3/image.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/en)

**Please review all of the tabs listed on this website**. You only need to show up for the events that you're competing in - but we encourage you to show up for longer. Note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, so please be ready for each event/round **about 30 minutes in advance**, just in-case.

To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz).

**Notice of filming and photography**: Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

Masks will be optional. Do not attend if you feel/are sick.

items.name: Berlin Summer Open 2025
items.information:
**Deutsch**

**Sommer in Berlin!** Wir laden euch herzlich ein zur Sommer Competition in Berlin. Wir, das Orga-Team, freuen uns auf euer zahlreiches Erscheinen. Euch erwartet eine schöne Venue mitten im Block des Märkischen Viertels in Berlin, tolle Disziplinen, Verpflegung, ein motiviertes Orga-Team und vieles mehr.

**Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Zeitplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.**

**English**

**Summer in Berlin!** We warmly invite you to our Summer competition in Berlin. We, the organizing team, look forward to seeing you in large numbers. You can expect a beautiful venue right in the middle of Märkisches Viertel, great events, food, a motivated organization team and much more.

**Please read all tabs carefully so you are familiar with the schedule and all modalities.**
